+# YouTube Channel AI Manager - Example Client Project
+
+This is an example client project demonstrating how to use Nezha for managing an AI-made YouTube channel.
+
+## Project Structure
+
+```
+youtube-channel-ai/
+├── skills/
+│   ├── video-creation.md
+│   ├── video-upload.md
+│   ├── thumbnail-design.md
+│   └── analytics-review.md
+├── tasks/
+│   └── weekly-content-plan.md
+├── config.yaml
+└── README.md
+```
+
+## How It Uses Nezha
+
+### 1. Task Management
+- Create content creation tasks
+- Track video production workflow
+- Schedule uploads
+
+### 2. Issue Tracking
+- Report video processing errors
+- Track copyright claims
+- Monitor community guideline issues
+
+### 3. Review System
+- AI reviews video scripts
+- Quality control for thumbnails
+- Performance review of published content
+
+### 4. DLQ Integration
+- Failed upload retries
+- API rate limit handling
+- Network error recovery
+
+## Skills for YouTube Management
+
+### video-creation.md
+```markdown
+# Video Creation Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Generate video content from text scripts using AI tools.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "create video"
+- "generate video content"
+- "make a video about"
+
+## Steps
+1. Parse topic and requirements
+2. Generate script using AI
+3. Create storyboard
+4. Generate visuals
+5. Add voiceover
+6. Export final video
+
+## Tools Required
+- Text-to-video AI (e.g., Runway, Pika)
+- Voice synthesis (e.g., ElevenLabs)
+- Video editing (e.g., FFmpeg)
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't create videos without script approval
+- Don't skip copyright checks
+- Don't ignore platform guidelines
+```
+
+### video-upload.md
+```markdown
+# Video Upload Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Upload videos to YouTube with proper metadata.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "upload video"
+- "publish to youtube"
+- "schedule upload"
+
+## Steps
+1. Validate video file
+2. Generate title and description
+3. Add tags and categories
+4. Set thumbnail
+5. Schedule or publish
+6. Verify upload success
+
+## Tools Required
+- YouTube Data API
+- OAuth2 credentials
+- Thumbnail generator
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't upload without metadata
+- Don't ignore upload errors
+- Don't skip thumbnail optimization
+```
+
+## Integration with Nezha
+
+### CLI Commands
+
+```bash
+# Create a video creation task
+node dist/cli/index.js task-add "Create weekly news video" "Generate 5-minute news summary video" 7
+
+# Track upload issues
+node dist/cli/index.js issue-add "Upload failed" "Video processing timeout" --type bug --severity high
+
+# Review video quality
+node dist/cli/index.js review-add "video-quality" "Weekly video quality check" --score 8
+```
+
+### Database Connection
+
+The client project connects to Nezha's PostgreSQL database:
+
+```typescript
+import { DatabaseClient } from 'nezha';
+
+const db = new DatabaseClient({
+  host: 'localhost',
+  database: 'nezha',
+  user: 'postgres',
+});
+
+// Create tasks for video production
+await db.query(`
+  INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, category, priority)
+  VALUES ($1, $2, 'content', $3)
+`, ['Create tutorial video', 'Step-by-step guide', 7]);
+```
+
+## Workflow Example
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                  YOUTUBE CHANNEL WORKFLOW                    │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                                              │
+│  1. CONTENT PLANNING                                        │
+│     ├── Create task: "Weekly content plan"                  │
+│     ├── AI generates topic ideas                            │
+│     └── Review and approve topics                           │
+│                                                              │
+│  2. VIDEO CREATION                                          │
+│     ├── Task: "Create video about X"                        │
+│     ├── Skill: video-creation.md                            │
+│     ├── Generate script                                     │
+│     ├── Create visuals                                      │
+│     └── Export video                                        │
+│                                                              │
+│  3. UPLOAD & PUBLISH                                        │
+│     ├── Task: "Upload video X"                              │
+│     ├── Skill: video-upload.md                              │
+│     ├── Add metadata                                        │
+│     ├── Schedule publish                                    │
+│     └── Verify success                                      │
+│                                                              │
+│  4. ANALYTICS REVIEW                                        │
+│     ├── Task: "Weekly analytics review"                     │
+│     ├── Skill: analytics-review.md                          │
+│     ├── Pull YouTube Analytics                              │
+│     ├── Generate report                                     │
+│     └── Create improvement issues                           │
+│                                                              │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+## Getting Started
+
+1. Clone Nezha repository
+2. Set up PostgreSQL database
+3. Create client project directory
+4. Add skills to Nezha skills table
+5. Start creating tasks
+
+## Benefits
+
+- **AI Collaboration**: Multiple AIs work on different aspects
+- **Task Tracking**: Never lose track of content pipeline
+- **Error Recovery**: DLQ handles upload failures
+- **Quality Control**: Review system ensures content quality
+- **Continuous Improvement**: Learn from analytics and feedback

+# YouTube Channel AI - Project Configuration
+
+project:
+  name: "youtube-channel-ai"
+  description: "AI-managed YouTube channel example"
+  version: "1.0.0"
+
+nezha:
+  database:
+    host: "localhost"
+    port: 5432
+    name: "nezha"
+    user: "postgres"
+
+youtube:
+  channel_id: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID"
+  api_key: "${YOUTUBE_API_KEY}"
+  oauth:
+    client_id: "${YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID}"
+    client_secret: "${YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET}"
+
+content:
+  schedule:
+    - day: "monday"
+      type: "tutorial"
+      time: "09:00"
+    - day: "wednesday"
+      type: "news"
+      time: "18:00"
+    - day: "friday"
+      type: "entertainment"
+      time: "12:00"
+
+  categories:
+    - "Education"
+    - "Technology"
+    - "Entertainment"
+
+ai:
+  video_generation:
+    provider: "runway"
+    model: "gen-2"
+  
+  voice:
+    provider: "elevenlabs"
+    voice_id: "default"
+
+  thumbnail:
+    provider: "dalle"
+    style: "youtube-thumbnail"
+
+monitoring:
+  analytics_check: "daily"
+  performance_threshold:
+    min_views: 100
+    min_ctr: 2.0
+    min_retention: 50
+
+skills:
+  - name: "video-creation"
+    path: "./skills/video-creation.md"
+    enabled: true
+  
+  - name: "video-upload"
+    path: "./skills/video-upload.md"
+    enabled: true
+  
+  - name: "analytics-review"
+    path: "./skills/analytics-review.md"
+    enabled: true

+# Analytics Review Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Analyze YouTube channel performance and generate improvement insights.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "review analytics"
+- "check channel performance"
+- "analyze video stats"
+- "weekly report"
+
+## Steps
+1. Fetch YouTube Analytics data
+2. Calculate key metrics
+3. Compare with previous period
+4. Identify top/bottom performers
+5. Generate improvement recommendations
+6. Create visual report
+
+## Tools Required
+- YouTube Analytics API
+- Data visualization library
+- Report generator
+
+## Metrics Tracked
+| Metric | Description |
+|--------|-------------|
+| Views | Total video views |
+| Watch time | Total watch time in hours |
+| CTR | Click-through rate |
+| Average view duration | Average watch time per video |
+| Subscribers | Net subscriber change |
+| Revenue | Ad revenue (if applicable) |
+
+## Output
+- Performance summary
+- Top/bottom videos
+- Trend analysis
+- Improvement recommendations
+- Issues to address
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't ignore declining metrics
+- Don't skip competitor analysis
+- Don't focus only on views
+- Don't neglect audience retention
+
+## Examples
+
+### Weekly analytics review
+```
+User: Review this week's analytics
+
+AI: I'll analyze this week's performance:
+1. Fetch last 7 days of data
+2. Compare with previous week
+3. Identify trends and anomalies
+4. Generate recommendations
+
+Results:
+- Views: 12,450 (+15% vs last week)
+- Watch time: 856 hours (+10%)
+- Top video: "Python Tutorial" (3,200 views)
+- Bottom video: "News Update" (450 views)
+- CTR: 4.2% (above average)
+
+Recommendations:
+1. Create more tutorial content
+2. Improve news video thumbnails
+3. Optimize video descriptions for SEO
+```
+
+### Video-specific analysis
+```
+User: Why did my last video underperform?
+
+AI: Analyzing video performance:
+1. Check retention curve
+2. Compare with similar videos
+3. Analyze traffic sources
+4. Review comments for feedback
+
+Findings:
+- High drop-off at 0:30 (intro too long)
+- Low CTR (thumbnail not engaging)
+- Limited search visibility
+
+Recommendations:
+1. Shorten intro to 10 seconds
+2. A/B test thumbnails
+3. Add more keywords in description
+```

+
+## Purpose

+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "create video"
+- "generate video content"

+## Steps

+4. Generate visuals
+5. Add voiceover
+6. Export final video
+

+- Text-to-video AI (e.g., Runway, Pika, Sora)
+- Voice synthesis (e.g., ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS)
+- Video editing (e.g., FFmpeg, MoviePy)
+
+## Parameters
+| Parameter | Type | Description |
+|-----------|------|-------------|
+| topic | string | Video topic |
+| duration | number | Target duration in seconds |
+| style | string | Visual style (realistic, animated, etc.) |
+| voice | string | Voice type for narration |
+
+## Output
+- Video file (MP4)
+- Script document
+- Thumbnail suggestions
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't create videos without script approval
+- Don't skip copyright checks
+- Don't ignore platform guidelines
+- Don't use unlicensed music
+
+## Examples
+
+### Creating a tutorial video
+```
+User: Create a 5-minute tutorial video about Python list comprehensions
+
+AI: I'll create a tutorial video following these steps:
+1. Generate script explaining list comprehensions
+2. Create code examples with visualizations
+3. Add voiceover with clear explanations
+4. Export as MP4 for YouTube upload
+```
+
+### Creating a news summary
+```
+User: Make a video about today's tech news
+
+AI: I'll create a news summary video:
+1. Fetch latest tech news from APIs
+2. Summarize top 5 stories
+3. Generate visuals for each story
+4. Add professional voiceover
+5. Export for upload
+```

+# Video Upload Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Upload videos to YouTube with proper metadata and optimization.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "upload video"
+- "publish to youtube"
+- "schedule upload"
+- "post video"
+
+## Steps
+1. Validate video file (format, size, duration)
+2. Generate optimized title and description
+3. Add tags and categories
+4. Set or generate thumbnail
+5. Schedule or publish immediately
+6. Verify upload success
+
+## Tools Required
+- YouTube Data API v3
+- OAuth2 credentials
+- Thumbnail generator
+- FFmpeg for validation
+
+## Parameters
+| Parameter | Type | Description |
+|-----------|------|-------------|
+| video_path | string | Path to video file |
+| title | string | Video title (auto-generated if not provided) |
+| description | string | Video description |
+| tags | string[] | Video tags |
+| category | string | YouTube category ID |
+| privacy | string | public, unlisted, or private |
+| schedule | datetime | Scheduled publish time |
+
+## Output
+- Video ID
+- Upload status
+- Published URL
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't upload without metadata
+- Don't ignore upload errors
+- Don't skip thumbnail optimization
+- Don't violate YouTube policies
+
+## Error Handling
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| Quota exceeded | Schedule retry after quota reset |
+| Invalid format | Convert video and retry |
+| Network error | Add to DLQ for retry |
+| Auth expired | Refresh token and retry |
+
+## Examples
+
+### Upload with auto-metadata
+```
+User: Upload the tutorial video
+
+AI: I'll upload the video with:
+1. Validate MP4 format and size
+2. Generate SEO-optimized title
+3. Create description with timestamps
+4. Add relevant tags
+5. Generate thumbnail
+6. Upload and verify
+```
+
+### Schedule upload
+```
+User: Schedule the video for tomorrow at 9 AM
+
+AI: I'll schedule the upload:
+1. Prepare all metadata
+2. Set scheduled time: tomorrow 9:00 AM
+3. Queue upload task
+4. Confirm scheduling
+```

+# Analytics Review Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Analyze YouTube channel performance and generate improvement insights.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "review analytics"
+- "check channel performance"
+- "analyze video stats"
+- "weekly report"
+
+## Steps

+2. Calculate key metrics
+3. Compare with previous period
+4. Identify top/bottom performers
+5. Generate improvement recommendations
+6. Create visual report
+
+## Tools Required
+- YouTube Analytics API
+- Data visualization library
+- Report generator
+
+## Metrics Tracked

+|--------|-------------|
+| Views | Total video views |
+| Watch time | Total watch time in hours |
+| CTR | Click-through rate |

+- Performance summary
+- Top/bottom videos
+- Trend analysis
+- Improvement recommendations
+- Issues to address
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't ignore declining metrics
+- Don't skip competitor analysis
+- Don't focus only on views
+- Don't neglect audience retention
+

+```
+User: Review this week's analytics

+# Video Upload Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Upload videos to YouTube with proper metadata and optimization.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "upload video"
+- "publish to youtube"
+- "schedule upload"
+- "post video"
+
+## Steps
+1. Validate video file (format, size, duration)
+2. Generate optimized title and description
+3. Add tags and categories
+4. Set or generate thumbnail
+5. Schedule or publish immediately
+6. Verify upload success
+
+## Tools Required
+- YouTube Data API v3
+- OAuth2 credentials
+- Thumbnail generator
+- FFmpeg for validation
+
+## Parameters
+| Parameter | Type | Description |
+|-----------|------|-------------|
+| video_path | string | Path to video file |
+| title | string | Video title (auto-generated if not provided) |
+| description | string | Video description |
+| tags | string[] | Video tags |
+| category | string | YouTube category ID |
+| privacy | string | public, unlisted, or private |
+| schedule | datetime | Scheduled publish time |

+## Output

+- Upload status
+- Published URL
+
+## Anti-Patterns
+- Don't upload without metadata
+- Don't ignore upload errors
+- Don't skip thumbnail optimization
+- Don't violate YouTube policies
+
+## Error Handling
+| Error | Action |
+|-------|--------|
+| Quota exceeded | Schedule retry after quota reset |
+| Invalid format | Convert video and retry |
+| Network error | Add to DLQ for retry |

+# YouTube Channel AI Manager - Example Client Project
+
+This is an example client project demonstrating how to use Nezha for managing an AI-made YouTube channel.
+
+## Project Structure
+
+```
+youtube-channel-ai/
+├── skills/
+│   ├── video-creation.md
+│   ├── video-upload.md
+│   ├── thumbnail-design.md
+│   └── analytics-review.md
+├── tasks/

+├── config.yaml
+└── README.md
+```
+
+## How It Uses Nezha
+
+### 1. Task Management
+- Create content creation tasks
+- Track video production workflow
+- Schedule uploads
+
+### 2. Issue Tracking
+- Report video processing errors
+- Track copyright claims
+- Monitor community guideline issues
+
+### 3. Review System
+- AI reviews video scripts
+- Quality control for thumbnails
+- Performance review of published content
+
+### 4. DLQ Integration
+- Failed upload retries
+- API rate limit handling
+- Network error recovery
+
+## Skills for YouTube Management
+
+### video-creation.md

+# Video Creation Skill
+
+## Purpose
+Generate video content from text scripts using AI tools.
+
+## Trigger Phrases
+- "create video"

+- "make a video about"
+
+## Steps

+2. Generate script using AI
+3. Create storyboard
+4. Generate visuals
+5. Add voiceover
+6. Export final video

+```

+## Integration with Nezha
+
+### CLI Commands
+
+```bash
+# Create a video creation task
+node dist/cli/index.js task-add "Create weekly news video" "Generate 5-minute news summary video" 7
+
+# Track upload issues
+node dist/cli/index.js issue-add "Upload failed" "Video processing timeout" --type bug --severity high
+
+# Review video quality
+node dist/cli/index.js review-add "video-quality" "Weekly video quality check" --score 8
+```
+
+### Database Connection
+
+The client project connects to Nezha's PostgreSQL database:
+
+```typescript
+import { DatabaseClient } from 'nezha';
+
+const db = new DatabaseClient({
+  host: 'localhost',
+  database: 'nezha',
+  user: 'postgres',
+});
+
+// Create tasks for video production
+await db.query(`
+  INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, category, priority)
+  VALUES ($1, $2, 'content', $3)
+`, ['Create tutorial video', 'Step-by-step guide', 7]);
+```
+
+## Workflow Example
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                  YOUTUBE CHANNEL WORKFLOW                    │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                                              │
+│  1. CONTENT PLANNING                                        │
+│     ├── Create task: "Weekly content plan"                  │
+│     ├── AI generates topic ideas                            │
+│     └── Review and approve topics                           │
+│                                                              │
+│  2. VIDEO CREATION                                          │

+│     ├── Generate script                                     │
+│     ├── Create visuals                                      │
+│     └── Export video                                        │
+│                                                              │
+│  3. UPLOAD & PUBLISH                                        │
+│     ├── Task: "Upload video X"                              │
+│     ├── Skill: video-upload.md                              │
+│     ├── Add metadata                                        │
+│     ├── Schedule publish                                    │
+│     └── Verify success                                      │
+│                                                              │
+│  4. ANALYTICS REVIEW                                        │
+│     ├── Task: "Weekly analytics review"                     │
+│     ├── Skill: analytics-review.md                          │
+│     ├── Pull YouTube Analytics                              │
+│     ├── Generate report                                     │
+│     └── Create improvement issues                           │
+│                                                              │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+## Getting Started
+
+1. Clone Nezha repository
+2. Set up PostgreSQL database
+3. Create client project directory
+4. Add skills to Nezha skills table
+5. Start creating tasks
+
+## Benefits
+
+- **AI Collaboration**: Multiple AIs work on different aspects
+- **Task Tracking**: Never lose track of content pipeline
+- **Error Recovery**: DLQ handles upload failures
+- **Quality Control**: Review system ensures content quality
+- **Continuous Improvement**: Learn from analytics and feedback

+
+project:
+  name: "youtube-channel-ai"
+  description: "AI-managed YouTube channel example"
+  version: "1.0.0"
+
+nezha:
+  database:
+    host: "localhost"
+    port: 5432
+    name: "nezha"
+    user: "postgres"
+

+  channel_id: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID"

+    client_id: "${YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID}"
+    client_secret: "${YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET}"
+
+content:
+  schedule:
+    - day: "monday"
+      type: "tutorial"
+      time: "09:00"
+    - day: "wednesday"
+      type: "news"
+      time: "18:00"
+    - day: "friday"
+      type: "entertainment"
+      time: "12:00"
+
+  categories:
+    - "Education"
+    - "Technology"
+    - "Entertainment"
+
+ai:
+  video_generation:
+    provider: "runway"
+    model: "gen-2"
+  
+  voice:
+    provider: "elevenlabs"
+    voice_id: "default"
+
+  thumbnail:
+    provider: "dalle"
+    style: "youtube-thumbnail"
+
+monitoring:
+  analytics_check: "daily"
+  performance_threshold:
+    min_views: 100
+    min_ctr: 2.0
+    min_retention: 50
+
+skills:
+  - name: "video-creation"
+    path: "./skills/video-creation.md"
+    enabled: true
+  
+  - name: "video-upload"
+    path: "./skills/video-upload.md"
+    enabled: true
+  
+  - name: "analytics-review"
+    path: "./skills/analytics-review.md"
+    enabled: true
